rationale: The agent was losing ~$19k to champions because crop_revenue_maximizer required a flat net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due + 350, paralyzing daytime seed planting for hours while fields sat idle, and oracle_frontrun required shed_used >= 25, missing fleeting peak price arbitrage windows. We relax the daytime cash constraint to allow continuous planting outside the midnight danger window (hour < 18), align seed budgeting directly to town shop 2x-3x contract demands, lower peak oracle monetization threshold to shed_used >= 12, and guide opportunistic workforce scaling up to 10 hands within farm execution.
